name: People's Republic of Bangladesh

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 130,170 km2 (World Bank AG.LND.TOTL.K2); high adds ~3% for inland water.

population.note: asOf 2025: 175,686,899 (World Bank). Range allows for 2026 change.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2024 p.248 as quoted: 171,250 active; CIA Factbook 2025 ~170,000. World Bank MS.MIL.TOTL.P1 227,000 (2020) includes paramilitary. Paramilitary 63,900 (BGB etc.) excluded.

trainedReserves.note: IISS: no organised reserve (0). High is an educated allowance for recalled ex-servicemen.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 171,250 minus infantry P roles 70,000 = 101,250. Navy (~25,000), Air Force (~14,000), crews, logistics, staff.

mobilizationRatio.note: Educated guess. No conscription, no reserve system; equipment-limited. 1% is ~1.8 million.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP (2011 int$) 1,220,276,046,757 / population 175,686,899 = 6,946. Range +/-15%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 1,524,392,313,250 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 1,220,276,046,757 2011 int$. Range +/-15% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/BGD/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD?format=json Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 0.81% of GDP in 2025. Factbook: 0.9% (2024), 1.1% (2022).

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 34.0% of GDP (World Bank).

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Near self-sufficient in rice, imports wheat; dense population leaves little surplus.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 86,366,729 x share of males aged 15-19 10.036% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 1,733,594. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

ships_minor.note: Educated guess. Khulna Shipyard and Chittagong Dry Dock build patrol craft. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_active_Bangladesh_Navy_ships)

roadKm.note: asOf 2018: 369,105 km total, 110,311 km paved (mid) (list as quoted).

railKm.note: asOf 2019: 2,877 route-km (World Bank). CIA Factbook 2,460 km (2014) as low. Mixed metre and broad gauge.

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 2 ports (1 medium Chittagong, 1 small Mongla); high adds Payra.

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: 6,019 thousand DWT under the national flag. Range +/-10%. 558 ships (Factbook 2023).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Short interior lines; river crossings constrain movement.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Mostly cattle/buffalo used for draught (not from FAO data); militarily marginal.

nuclearWarheads.note: FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists nine nuclear-armed states; Bangladesh is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.1-1.2: familiar riverine terrain (monsoon floods, river lines), population support.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with a 2026 order of battle. Population inside ne:BGD; ~1 million Rohingya refugees in Cox's Bazar counted by the World Bank population. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Counts from the Wikipedia Bangladesh Army equipment list (many 'sources vary' ranges), BAF article and Bangladesh Navy ship list (grade B/C). Politics: interim government after the August 2024 uprising; elections held February 2026. Infantry splits are educated guesses. Paramilitary (BGB, Ansar/VDP) excluded.
